summary.business_type: Local Service — electronics repair, two physical branches in Tehran
summary.audit_scope: 15 sample pages of 893 sitemap URLs, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, HTTP headers, llms.txt
limitations: seo-audit skill ships no scripts/ directory — render_page.py, google_auth.py and backlinks_auth.py were unavailable
No CrUX field data, no Search Console indexation data, no backlink profile
Live site audited; uncommitted local changes from 2026-07-19 are not reflected
top_findings: TTFB 1.04-1.11s on static HTML — caps LCP across all 893 pages
No security headers at all (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy)
~40 images missing alt text; 25 of 51 (49%) on the mobile hub page
/contact/ title is 4 characters — wasted SERP slot for a local business
Hub pages emit 421KB raw HTML with heavy DOM (58 images, 35 H2s on /samsung/mobile/)
quick_wins: Set Cache-Control and enable Brotli on nginx
Add Persian alt text to ~40 brand logo images
Add four security headers to nginx config

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 15 sampled pages return 200 with no redirect chains
Self-referencing canonical correct on every page
robots meta is index, follow sitewide
sitemap.xml lists 893 URLs with priority, lastmod, changefreq
Exactly one H1 per page across all samples
gzip active: /samsung/ compresses 421KB to 80KB

findings.title: TTFB around 1.1s on static HTML
findings.description: Three consecutive homepage measurements: 1.114s, 1.042s, 1.099s to first byte. Interior pages 253-551ms. For a fully static export served by nginx this originates in hosting, not the application.
findings.recommendation: Put the domain behind a CDN with in-country nodes, or move to faster hosting. Target sub-200ms. No front-end work can bring LCP under 2.5s while TTFB is ~1s.

findings.title: No security headers present
findings.description: Server response carries only Server, Vary and Cache-Control. HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy are all absent.
findings.recommendation: Add the four headers to the nginx server block with the always flag.

findings.title: HTML cache policy forces revalidation
findings.description: Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate on HTML. Combined with ~1s TTFB every repeat visit pays full latency.
findings.recommendation: Use public, max-age=600, stale-while-revalidate=86400.

findings.title: Hashed static assets cached for only 14 days
findings.description: /_next/static/chunks/webpack-10031099b5931091.js returns max-age=1209600 despite having a content hash in the filename.
findings.recommendation: Set max-age=31536000, immutable for /_next/static/.

findings.title: Brotli not enabled
findings.description: Server negotiates gzip only. Brotli is typically 15-20% smaller, material on 400KB HTML documents.
findings.recommendation: Enable brotli for text/html, css, js, json, svg.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Hub pages run 4,359 to 10,996 words, deeper than most competitors
Rich heading structure: 35 H2s on /samsung/mobile/, 27 on /samsung/
FAQ section on nearly every service page, aligned with FAQPage schema
NAP consistent sitewide across two branches

findings.title: Generic boilerplate on the money pages
findings.description: /samsung/ carries 10,749 words including sections like '9 reasons we are the best choice' built from unverifiable claims. That page holds 15,430 monthly impressions but sits at position ~17, consistent with Helpful Content demotion of high-volume low-specificity copy.
findings.recommendation: Partially addressed 2026-07-19 (not yet deployed): a direct-answer block, facts table, real price ranges for 79 models and a 'when we do not recommend repair' section now sit above the legacy copy. Continue by trimming the unverifiable claim sections.

findings.title: Blog listing page is thin
findings.description: /blog/ has 679 words and zero H2 elements.
findings.recommendation: Group posts under topical H2s with a short intro per group.

findings.title: No real customer reviews
findings.description: CUSTOMER_REVIEWS in lib/pricing.ts is intentionally empty so no aggregateRating is emitted. Correct call, but the site lacks a strong local signal competitors have.
findings.recommendation: Collect genuine reviews post-handover or via Google Business Profile, then enable aggregateRating from real data only.

findings.title: Author signal is generic
findings.description: Person schema points to a general editorial identity rather than named technicians with verifiable expertise.
findings.recommendation: Build a technician team page using the real workshop photo library.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Most titles fall in the 54-71 character range
Meta descriptions 104-149 characters, none missing
Titles lead with the keyword then a concrete benefit
Open Graph and Twitter Card present on all sampled pages
BreadcrumbList schema on every interior page

findings.title: /contact/ title is 4 characters
findings.description: Title is simply the word for 'contact'. For a two-branch local business this page should compete for address and phone queries that appear in the 438-keyword list.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to include both branch names and the business name.

findings.title: Hisense title short and uses low-volume spelling
findings.description: 30-character title spelling the term without a space, while the 171-impression query uses the spaced form.
findings.recommendation: Fixed 2026-07-19, pending deploy.

findings.title: Duplicated word in Motorola title
findings.description: Title repeats the same word twice. This page is the site's best performer at position 3 with 20.59% CTR.
findings.recommendation: Remove the duplicate only. Do not restructure a page that is already winning.

findings.title: Emoji in title tag
findings.description: /nothingphone-repair/ includes a phone emoji, contrary to the project's own content rules in CLAUDE.md.
findings.recommendation: Strip the emoji.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: No JSON-LD parse errors across 15 sampled pages
LocalBusiness, Organization, WebSite, Person on every page
BreadcrumbList on 14 pages, Service on 10, FAQPage on 9
HowTo on the repair request page, CollectionPage plus ItemList on the blog index

findings.title: Price tables not marked up as Offer
findings.description: 260 real price rows render as HTML tables with no Offer or AggregateOffer markup.
findings.recommendation: Emit AggregateOffer with minPrice and maxPrice per model to earn rich results and AI citations.

findings.title: aggregateRating absent
findings.description: Deliberate and correct while no genuine reviews exist.
findings.recommendation: Enable once real reviews are collected. Never populate from invented data.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Explicit width and height on 100% of images — CLS effectively protected
Lazy loading active on below-fold images
WebP format sitewide

findings.title: TTFB sets the LCP ceiling
findings.description: At ~1s to first byte, LCP cannot realistically drop below 1.5-2s even with perfect rendering, and will exceed 2.5s on Iranian mobile networks.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as the technical finding: CDN or faster origin.

findings.title: Heavy DOM on hub pages
findings.description: /samsung/mobile/ renders 58 images and 35 H2s in one document, 416KB raw HTML.
findings.recommendation: Collapse lower sections into accordions to cut DOM cost without removing content.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended and CCBot
/llms.txt returns 200
FAQPage schema on 9 pages
Content present in rendered HTML via static export, no JS dependency

findings.title: Pages did not open with a direct answer
findings.description: Pages opened with brand introductions rather than self-contained quotable statements.
findings.recommendation: Fixed 2026-07-19 on 8 target pages, pending deploy.

findings.title: Numbers locked inside tables
findings.description: Prices existed only in HTML table cells, which models cite less readily than in-sentence figures.
findings.recommendation: Fixed 2026-07-19: real price ranges now appear inside prose, pending deploy.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP sitewide
Explicit dimensions on every image
Lazy loading below the fold

findings.title: Roughly 40 images missing alt text
findings.description: Mobile hub 25 of 51 (49%), /samsung/mobile/ 10 of 58, /samsung/ 9 of 35, /apple/ 2 of 24, /hp/lap-top/ 2 of 19, /smart-watch-repair/ 1 of 17. Affected files are brand logos: realme.webp, oppo.webp, oneplus.webp, vivo.webp, samsung.webp, apple-1-150x150.webp.
findings.recommendation: Script alt injection into content/posts.json by filename match.
